disposition.description: How the call ended. 'surveyed' is the only one that carries a full set of answers; the rest say why it does not.

gating_facts.description: Work-item values that decided which questions this member was asked — the risk tier, as supplied. Reported so a reader can tell why a question was or was not put.

answers.description: Question slot -> the member's answer. Choice answers are one of the option values declared for the slot; free-text answers are the member's own words.

declined_questions.description: Questions that were put and that the member would not answer. Never a reason to end the call.

skipped_questions.description: Questions the script did not apply to this member, with the condition that ruled them out.

missing_questions.description: Applicable questions that were never answered — because the call ended first, not because the member declined.

visited_nodes.description: Script node ids, in the order the agent acted on them.

open_intents.description: Anything the member raised that was never resolved.
